topography.project_purpose: Farm. Structurally: 149 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 60 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 34 common project-authored base contract(s) (ethvault, vaultimmutables, vaultadmin). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
